createGenerate.title: Recovery phrase
createGenerate.instructions: Write down these 12 words somewhere safe. This is the only way to recover access to your account.

createConfirm.instructions: Enter the phrase again to confirm that you've saved it.

importMnemonic.title: Sign in with recovery phrase
importMnemonic.instructions: Enter your recovery phrase (12 words separated by spaces).
importMnemonic.label: Recovery phrase

importKey.title: Sign in with a key
importKey.instructions: Enter your private key in nsec1... format or as a hex string (64 characters).
importKey.explanation: A private key is a secret string that gives full access to your account. Never show it to anyone. In nsec format (NIP-19, bech32) it starts with nsec1 and looks something like this:
importKey.exampleNote: (this is just an example format, not a real key)
importKey.label: Private key
importKey.wrongTypeError: This isn't a private key (nsec), it's {{type}}. Check what you copied.

done.title: Done
done.quickRegisterWarning: Quick registration: your secret recovery phrase was not shown or saved anywhere. If this device or browser storage is lost, there will be no way to recover access to your account. You can show the phrase for backup later in settings.

hero.title: A private space for messaging without a central server
hero.lead: {{appName}} is a messenger built on the Nostr protocol with end-to-end encryption (MLS) for conversations and device-side database encryption. Works on a local network, without the public internet.

tempChat.title: Temporary chat
tempChat.lead1: Soon you'll be able to create a disposable room here and invite other guests into it — by text or voice, without registration and without exchanging keys beforehand. The room will disappear on its own an hour after it's empty.
